_comment: License (PAY_FIRST 先付后用) client-software product: the user pays receivePayment.productPrice (>= 1, no ¥0 buyout) BEFORE first use, then activates a license edition. Unlike TRIAL_FIRST there is no mandatory trialDays (omit it); per-edition trialCount is only meaningful under the QUOTA pricing model (licensePricingModel=QUOTA) — under the default EDITION model trials are day-based and the publish form does not even show a trial-count field. Keep the pricing/edition rules in reference.md in mind (edition prices strictly ascending when licensePlatformPayment=true).

baseInfo.summary: A pay-first license-gated desktop app: buy once, download, then activate per edition.

introduce.functions: Offline-first sync, command palette, plugin marketplace, cross-device clipboard, and granular license tiers.
introduce.targetUserGroup: Knowledge workers, indie hackers and small teams who want a fast, private productivity tool.
introduce.usageScenarios: Daily note-taking, task planning and team knowledge sharing across Windows machines.
introduce.painPoints: Existing tools are either cloud-only or lack fair tiered licensing.
